asr.full_text: Garlic Today I am going to tell you about Garlic Which is also known as Lahsan and in Medical context called Allium Sativum All over the world Garlic is widely available all over the world and garlic is considered to be very efficient in our Ayurveda, in our old traditions. As soon as our analysis was done we came to know that if you take 100 grams of garlic it has 145 calories There is every type of amount in it, There is carbohydrate, protein and fat Garlic benefits in 3-4 ways First garlic is usedin which reduces blood pressure. Garlic plays a very good role in diabetes because it contains lots of sulphur which reduces insulin resistance and it is also good for diabetes. garlic can control diabetes, 3. Garlic reduces body's toxicity specially. If liver has any damage then taking garlic can helps in improving body's toxicity 4. It can treat Entry Microbiel It can be a good drug for you, and then the best effect is antimicrobial which will kill any germs that may be present so, these are the main benefits of Garlic I can say that some people don't like its smell For people who don't eat garlic for a long time they feel that its smell is too much because of sulphur compound as its flavor is too strong because if we take some extra amount of this we can reduce the problem of the smell otherwise garlic gives usefulness someone ask me sir how much garlic should i take i say about 4 gms per day, then it is enough if take more than than 4 gms then it is dangerous so how to take 4 grams, take some of the 1 after each of two pieces of garlic and you can use as powder so you have to take little extra amount people ask me, why do you have to take garlics? so how to take it in this form? so one you can take by chewing, peeling and eating garlic is best as in its raw form first take it in the form as chew and then go. 2. Garlic is very common use in various meals and other people add it in all the dishes like the seasoning. we also use garlic in the zero oil cooking it is very beneficial for our body There is one more use of garlic, we can reduce the pain and inflammation by making it by heating it with oil sometimes we get pain in the joint, so you must remember that old ladies used to do by putting garlic in oil.. ..and it helped to cure the problem. This is used even for cough, cough. These days garlic bread is a popular means of protein. So I am adding garlic to the bread. It can be used as a topping for garlic powder.. As you have made food you can sprinkle garlic on it So, many different ways of using garlic If you ask me to follow medicine Eat it with two cups of it and also take all these information which I have given you This garlic is the most found the most in India. I know there are some religions where there's no garlic and I never want to force them to make garlic milk. That's right, you can do it because garlic is beneficial. as you are aware that I am Dr Bimal Chahadgar. I make heart treatments without bypass surgery or angioplasty.
